schemes.name: Free NHS prescriptions
schemes.how: In England, tick the box on the back of the prescription that matches the reason. They're free for everyone in Scotland and Wales.

rule.expr: lives in Scotland or Wales, 60 or over, or pregnant
rule.txt: Lives in Scotland or Wales, is 60 or over, or is pregnant
rule.fail: None of the usual reasons apply. A prepayment certificate caps the cost.

schemes.name: Free NHS eye test
schemes.gives: A sight test without the charge.
schemes.how: Tell the optician when you book. Eye tests are free for everyone in Scotland.

rule.expr: lives in Scotland, or is 60 or over
rule.txt: Lives in Scotland, or is 60 or over
rule.fail: Not by age. Some health conditions and benefits also make it free.

schemes.name: Free NHS dental treatment
schemes.gives: NHS dental treatment without the charge, during pregnancy and for 12 months after the birth.
schemes.how: Tell your dentist before treatment and show your maternity exemption certificate.

rule.fail: Scotland and Wales set their own dental charges: ask your dentist

rule.expr: pregnant, or had a baby in the last 12 months
rule.txt: Pregnant, or had a baby in the last 12 months
rule.fail: Not pregnant and no baby under 1

schemes.name: NHS Low Income Scheme
schemes.gives: Help with prescriptions, dental, eye and travel costs for hospital visits, in full or in part.
schemes.how: Apply online or on an HC1 form. It looks at income, council tax and rent, so it can help people whose income is too high for benefits.
schemes.timing: Refunds must be claimed within 3 months of paying.
schemes.worthChecking: Depends on a full look at income and housing costs

rule.fail: Scotland and Wales run their own help with health costs

schemes.name: Healthcare Travel Costs Scheme
schemes.gives: A refund of travel costs to hospital or specialist appointments you were referred to.
schemes.how: Claim at the hospital, usually on the day, with proof of your benefit. Only for referred appointments, not GP visits.
schemes.worthChecking: Only for appointments you were referred to

rule.fail: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have their own travel help

rule.expr: gets Universal Credit or Pension Credit
rule.txt: Gets Universal Credit or Pension Credit
rule.fail: Needs Universal Credit or Pension Credit
